title: /integrations/gogogate2
description: Instructions on how to integrate Gogogate2 and iSmartGate enabled garage door covers into Home Assistant.
body:
The **Gogogate2 and ismartgate**  lets you control Gogogate2 and iSmartGate enabled garage doors and gates through Home Assistant. Device names in Home Assistant are generated based on the names defined in the GogoGate2 or iSmartGate mobile app.

### Supported devices

- Gogogate 2
- ismartgate PRO
- ismartgate LITE
- ismartgate MINI
